# Biopython 1.85
from Bio.Seq import Seq
from Bio.Restriction import RestrictionBatch

seq = Seq("")
enzymes = RestrictionBatch(["BamHI"])

# 1-based position of the first base after each top-strand cut
sites = enzymes.search(seq, linear=False)
print(sites)

cuts = sorted({pos for hits in sites.values() for pos in hits})
# Circular: n cuts give n fragments
sizes = [(cuts[(i + 1) % len(cuts)] - c) % len(seq) or len(seq) for i, c in enumerate(cuts)]
print(sorted(sizes, reverse=True))
